description: Full-text search across Swiss court decisions aggregated by entscheidsuche.ch: Federal Supreme Court (BGer/BGE), Federal Administrative Court (BVGer), Federal Criminal Court (BStGer), Federal Patent Court and the courts of all 26 cantons. Returns docket/reference number, decision date, court, canton, title, abstract snippet, matching text excerpts and a link to the decision (PDF/HTML). Query syntax: words are AND-ed; use "quotes" for phrases, | for OR, - to exclude. Examples: query='Mietzins Kündigung' canton='ZH'; query='"Art. 336 OR"' court='BGer' date_from='2020'; query='5A_123/2020'.

court.description: Court: 'BGer', 'BGE', 'BVGer', 'BStGer', 'BPatGer', or an index code like 'ZH_OG' / 'CH_BGer'

language.description: Preferred language for titles/abstracts (boosted, not filtered)

query.description: Search terms, a legal provision or a docket number

name: search_court_decisions
title: Search Swiss court decisions
